svg.text: B · pipeline: each stage hands work to the next queue (with outbox)

Work: check → extract. Stages report to the status queue (read only by the API) when the user should know. One ZIP per document version (stored, no compression: PNG bytes and page hashes unchanged). Statuses: Uploaded (UI: "processing") → Blocked | PendingReview → Approved → Archived, or Failed; a newer version makes older unfinished ones Superseded; results are

stored at PendingReview, only Approved ones are read (one per document). Alternatives are alt frames; red ✗ = state after an infrastructure failure. Service Bus Basic has no duplicate detection: receivers are idempotent. SLA targets are proposals (p95).
Mask in the browser · measured: 6–8 s/page on a phone, 11–28 s/page on a 2017 laptop
1. the user picks the file; originalSha256 = SHA-256 of the original (several photos: of their sorted hashes)
2. GET /documents?originalSha256={h} (a hash only; before any masking)
3. SELECT Document WHERE userId=@me AND originalSha256=@h
5. "Imported already": open it, or "import as a new version" (U9); nothing is masked or sent
7. render, OCR, zone masking, leak check; the user approves the masked pages; pack them into a ZIP
✗ nothing was sent: no state anywhere, the user starts again
Browser closed here: nothing is lost on the server,
because nothing was sent. The original stays on the device.
8. POST /documents (application/zip: pages/{pageSha}.png + manifest.json { order[], keptRegions[], originalSha256 })
✗ network error: nothing stored, or stored and the UI does not know it; the retry lands in "uploaded already" below
9. limits: ≤ 50 MB, ≤ 200 pages, PNG ≤ 25 MP from the header; today's imports < 10 (else 429). Unzip in memory: stored entries only, names from the manifest, PNG only; recompute page hashes
11. SELECT Document WHERE userId=@me AND originalSha256=@h
✗ SQL paused: waits for it to wake up; on timeout 503, UI retries
12. 200 { docId, verId, status } (existing document; UI offers to open it)
13. docId, verId = new UUIDv7 (Guid.CreateVersion7), generated before any write
✗ API dies here: orphan ZIP, no row; the lifecycle deletes it after 24 h
15. TX: INSERT Document (UNIQUE userId + originalSha256), Version(Uploaded); INSERT Outbox(CheckRequested); COMMIT
✗ rollback: no row, orphan ZIP as above; 500, UI retries. Unique violation (parallel retry): 200 with the existing document
✗ response lost: the document exists, the UI finds it in the list
[uploaded already: a retry, or another tab, since the hash check]
[invalid: not a stored ZIP, not PNG, unknown name, page hash ≠ manifest]
Browser closed after 202: the server carries on.
Next visit: the list shows the current status.
17. SELECT Outbox WHERE sentAt IS NULL
✗ SQL down: relay retries; status stays Uploaded
18. send check: CheckRequested { userId, docId, verId }
✗ Service Bus down: row stays unsent, relay retries; status stays Uploaded
✗ not marked: sent again; the receiver treats it as a duplicate
Checker · target: Blocked, or handed to the extractor, within 1 min of the upload
20. CheckRequested { userId, docId, verId } + deliveryCount; the lock is renewed while working
✗ checker down: message waits in the queue; status stays Uploaded
23. send extract: ExtractRequested { userId, docId, verId } (again; the extractor is idempotent)
[clean ZIP exists: the earlier try passed it, maybe crashed before reporting]
[no clean ZIP: the earlier try blocked or failed it and reported it, or the document was deleted]
25. verify page hashes, shape check, OCR + zone rules (in memory, nothing stored)
27. send extract: ExtractRequested { userId, docId, verId }
✗ crash before sending: redelivered, the resume alt sends it
28. send status: Blocked { userId, docId, verId, regions[]: {page,x,y,w,h,rule} }
29. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: integrity }
[blocked: ink outside the kept regions, or personal data found by OCR]
[broken: a page hash or PNG does not match]
✗ not deleted: the lifecycle removes it after 24 h
[incoming ZIP missing: an earlier try got this far]
31. abandon: Service Bus delivers it again later
32. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: check_error }
[an exception (OCR error, out of memory caught) and deliveryCount < 5]
✗ not completed (crash): delivered again; the first alt finds the work done
No "Checked" status: a clean document goes straight on to the extractor.
One version gets exactly one of: Blocked, Extracted, Failed.
✗ API asleep: the queue scale rule wakes it (about 30 s + cold start); the event waits
36. UPDATE Version SET Blocked + regions | Failed + reason WHERE verId AND status=Uploaded
37. complete; the UI sees the new status on its next poll
[0 rows: a duplicate, an old version, or the document was deleted]
Extractor · target: PendingReview within 3 min of the upload
39. ExtractRequested { userId, docId, verId } + deliveryCount; the lock (5 min at most) is renewed while working
✗ extractor down: waits; status stays Uploaded. Lock not renewed: a second delivery runs in parallel; the first status wins
42. send status: Extracted { userId, docId, verId } (from the saved results; no DI, no OpenAI)
45. build an image-only PDF of all pages in memory (never stored)
✗ DI down or 429: see the error alt below
47. { pages[]: words, lines, tables, bbox } (page number → pageSha by manifest order)
48. chat(masked text and tables of the batch, JSON schema)
✗ OpenAI down or 429: see the error alt below
49. { results[]: name, value, unit, range, dates, pageSha, bbox }
50. validate with pydantic: schema, numbers, units, dates; if invalid: one retry with the errors
[for each batch of pages (5 to start; tuned with evals)]
51. PUT text/{userId}/{docId}/{verId}.json { words[] per pageSha, fragments[], results[] }
52. send status: Extracted { userId, docId, verId }
53. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: no_results }
54. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: extract_invalid }
[all batches valid, at least one result]
[valid, but no results: not a lab result]
[clean ZIP missing: the document was deleted meanwhile]
[results already saved: an earlier try crashed before reporting]
56. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: extract_error }
[DI or OpenAI error (429, 5xx, timeout) and deliveryCount < 5]
✗ not completed (crash): delivered again; the first alt resends from the saved results
✗ API asleep: the queue scale rule wakes it; the event waits
✗ blob missing (document deleted): complete and ignore
60. TX: UPDATE Version SET PendingReview WHERE verId AND status=Uploaded; if 1 row: INSERT Extraction(model, prompt and dictionary versions), LabResult[]; COMMIT
✗ SQL error: rollback; abandon, delivered again
61. complete; the UI sees PendingReview on its next poll
[0 rows: a duplicate, a superseded version, or the document was deleted]
✗ API asleep: the queue scale rule wakes it (about 30 s + cold start); the event waits
64. UPDATE Version SET Failed + reason WHERE verId AND status=Uploaded
65. complete; the UI sees the new status on its next poll
[0 rows: a duplicate, an old version, or the document was deleted]
Review (user): are the values the AI extracted correct? · no SLA: waits for a person
The masking was approved in the browser before the upload.
Here the user checks only the extracted values against the masked pages.
✗ API asleep: waits for the cold start
68. SELECT Version, LabResult[] WHERE userId=@me AND verId AND status=PendingReview; SELECT Alias (shared) for the printed names
69. per row: suggest a parameter (1 alias, 2 ICD-9 PL code, 3 similar known name, 4 the model's suggestion from extraction); compute the flag if the lab printed none
70. { rowVersion, results[] + pageSha + bbox + suggestion { parameter, source } + condition + flags (lab, computed) }
74. "This document was deleted", back to the list
79. show values without highlighting (the review still works)
81. unzip (JSZip); each value next to its place on the page; the user corrects values or rejects rows
82. per new printed name: confirm or change the parameter; set the measurement condition (fasting, after a load, …) with one click
83. lab flag ≠ computed flag: shown in red (often an extraction error)
84. "Nothing to approve": delete the document (U8) or reprocess it (U9); the approve button stays off
Browser closed during review: corrections are lost,
status stays PendingReview, the user starts the review again.
85. POST /documents/{docId}/versions/{verId}/approve { rowVersion, corrections[], rejected[], mappings[]: { name, material, condition, parameter } }
✗ network error: still PendingReview, UI retries (rowVersion makes a repeat harmless)
86. GET text/{userId}/{docId}/{verId}.json (fragments: comments and descriptions, never result rows)
✗ OpenAI down: 503, nothing written; still PendingReview, UI retries

89. TX: UPDATE Version SET Approved WHERE verId AND status=PendingReview AND rowVersion=@rv; if 1 row: apply corrections, DELETE rejected rows, set parameter + condition, normalised value and computed flag (code, conversion table version), INSERT Alias (shared) if new, SET Archived on the previous Approved version, INSERT Fragment(text, vector)[]; COMMIT
✗ response lost: approved anyway; the UI shows it on refresh
92. already Approved: show it; otherwise reload the review (corrections kept in the form)
[0 rows: approved already (a retry), or rowVersion changed (new extraction, another tab)]
[ZIP missing: the document was deleted meanwhile]
Approval sends no message, so there is no outbox and no gap here. Fragments and vectors are written in the same
transaction: no indexing stage. One Approved version per document; the previous one becomes Archived.
U5 · Browse results and trends (most frequent: ~60 reads per import) · target: < 1 s when warm; a long cold start is accepted
After idle time the API container and the serverless SQL are asleep:
the first request waits for them to start (accepted, not measured).
✗ API asleep: waits for the cold start; UI shows a spinner
94. SELECT LabResult WHERE userId=@me AND status=Approved AND parameterId=@p ORDER BY date (one Approved version per document)
✗ SQL paused: wakes up, the request waits; on timeout 503, UI retries
95. { series[] + range, flag, docId, verId, pageSha }
96. chart; out-of-range marked by flag (computed by code, not by a model)
97. GET /documents/{docId}/versions/{verId}/pages (user clicks a point: the source page)
100. refresh the chart; the point is gone
101. ZIP (masked pages); UI opens the page {pageSha}
U6 · Ask the agent (~5 questions per import) · target: full answer < 15 s when warm; the UI shows progress
102. check the question: PESEL, e-mail, phone, address
103. block, explain what to remove (nothing sent)
104. POST /chat { question, history[] } (one JSON answer, not a stream; the history lives in the browser tab only)
✗ network error: nothing stored anywhere, the user asks again
105. the same identifier check (the browser is not trusted); today's questions < 50, else 429
✗ OpenAI down or 429: 503, UI says "try again"; nothing stored
108. tool_call get_trend("vitamin D", from, to) | search_text("comment about the sample")
109. SELECT … WHERE userId=@me AND status=Approved (same queries as U5)
✗ SQL paused: waits; on timeout the tool returns an error and the model says so
112. SELECT TOP 5 … WHERE userId=@me AND status=Approved ORDER BY VECTOR_DISTANCE(cosine, embedding, @v)
113. tool result { rows[] + docId, verId, pageSha }
[loop while the model calls tools; at most 5 calls, then the model must answer]
114. answer text + citations[]: { docId, verId, pageSha }
115. guardrail: every number must match a tool result, every claim must be cited
✗ response lost: UI offers "ask again"; nothing stored
117. 200 { the raw results table, "ask your doctor" } (no generated text)
Always: the sweeper (every 5 min while the API is awake; a cron rule wakes it once a day)
118. SELECT Version WHERE status=Uploaded AND updatedAt < now() − 10 min
120. the UI shows "Retry"; the outbox already guarantees the message was sent
plaintext original or unmasked personal data
note: a fact, e.g. the user closes the browser
✗ if this step fails: state of the system
